origin: LTspice schematics drawn by the maintainer for M17, their -netlist exports, and variants of the exports, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: Exported by LTspice 26.1.1 with -netlist, with Default Devices and Default Libraries off; the first comment line holds the absolute schematic path in the export and is replaced by the file name. A variant's first line says what it changes. The FRA files include jellybean.lib from openjellybean 0.5.0 (https://github.com/xdylanm/openjellybean, MIT), which is not copied here: the solver sweep runs them when OPENJELLYBEAN_LIB names that file.

.gitignore.note: Keeps LTspice run output and the jellybean.lib copy out, as in ltspice_transistors.

test_ltspice_fra.asc.note: Drawn by the maintainer in LTspice 26.1.1: a closed loop with the fra (@) and fraprobe (&) symbols and a .fra directive.

test_ltspice_fra_flist.cir.note: test_ltspice_fra.net with flist= over a + line (variant).

test_ltspice_fra_lists.cir.note: test_ltspice_fra.net with pp= and nmax= pairs and ac=1,0 (variant).

test_ltspice_fra_named.cir.note: test_ltspice_fra.net with the analyzer and its probe named @A and &a (variant).

test_ltspice_fra_nets.cir.note: test_ltspice_fra.net with refnode=, intnode= and a braced delay (variant).

test_ltspice_fra_zm.cir.note: test_ltspice_fra.net with ZM and without its probe, which LTspice refuses in impedance mode (variant).

test_ltspice_functions.asc.note: Drawn by the maintainer in LTspice 26.1.1: counter, phidet, modulate, modulate2, sample and varistor (COUNTER, PHASEDET, MODULATOR, SAMPLEHOLD, VARISTOR).

test_ltspice_gates.asc.note: Drawn by the maintainer in LTspice 26.1.1: buf, inv and buf1 (each BUF), and, or, xor, dflop and srflop, with Vhigh=, Trise= and Td= on some.

test_ltspice_gates_params.cir.note: test_ltspice_gates.net with lower-case function names and a braced value (variant).

test_ltspice_ota.asc.note: Drawn by the maintainer in LTspice 26.1.1: ota, mota and mota8 (each OTA), with G=, Iout= and Rout=.

test_ltspice_schmitt.asc.note: Drawn by the maintainer in LTspice 26.1.1: schmitt, schmtbuf, schmtinv and a diff variant (each SCHMITT), with Vt= and Vh=.
